Class GreedyGCA.GreedyVertex

java.lang.Object
DSA.Graphs.GCA.GreedyGCA.GreedyVertex
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<GreedyGCA.GreedyVertex>
Enclosing class:
GreedyGCA
public static class GreedyGCA.GreedyVertex extends Object implements Comparable<GreedyGCA.GreedyVertex>
A helper class representing a vertex with its ID and neighbors for greedy coloring. Implements Comparable to sort vertices by degree and ID.
